verdict.summary: The round-1 population-predicate defect is substantively corrected. The record now distinguishes the broad worker-lane classifier from the strict producer/backfill branch shape, adds same-repository and bot-author gates, pins positive and negative lookalike cases, and identifies the separate enrolled orchestrator population that a grammar-only generator would silently omit. It also requires complete-or-refuse pagination and explicitly permits refusal for targets whose orchestrator class is not correctly enumerable. The added cross-reference in the #608 design record is consistent with these findings. I found no remaining blocker or major issue in this documentation-only change.
